        pco.customer_id,
        pco.pizza_id,
        COALESCE(pco.exclusions, '') AS exclusions,
        COALESCE(pco.extras, '') AS extras,
        pco.order_time,
        pn.pizza_name
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders AS pco
    LEFT JOIN pizza_names AS pn ON pco.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        pizza_id,
        TRIM(SUBSTR(toppings, 1, LENGTH(toppings) - 1)) AS raw_toppings
    FROM pizza_recipes
)
